description: React component implementing a Sign Up page with email/password registration, role selection, and integration with Supabase auth API. The file manages form state, validation, and user profile creation upon sign-up.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates email, password, and role inputs.

methods.name: upsertProfile
methods.description: Inserts or updates the user's profile in the database.

methods.name: insertAdminIfNeeded
methods.description: Inserts the user into admin_users table if role is admin.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, calls signUp API, manages user session, and navigates upon success.
